title: Let the request teardown commit post edits
bug: Edits answer 200 but are never saved: reading the post shows the old text.

review.why: The PR removes an explicit `db.session.commit()` in the PUT /api/posts/<id> endpoint, relying on the request teardown to commit the session instead. This is an intentional refactoring announced in the PR description and does not change the API's behavior for clients.
